<description>
`feature_torcontrol.py` can fail if the node reconnects before the test thread starts checking the backoff. This caused an intermittent CI failure on NetBSD even though the node observed the expected delay.

Record when the mock Tor server accepts the new connection and compare that timestamp with the time just before triggering the disconnect. This preserves both checks: at least half a second must have elapsed, and the node must send `PROTOCOLINFO 1` on reconnect.

On Linux, the 1.5-second delay from the issue reproduced the original failure. The updated test passed both with and without that delay.

Fixes #36934.
</description>
